context: Supplemental add-on benchmark conducted AFTER the original heldout results were known. This is NOT a prospective blind selection experiment or a fresh holdout. Reader-LM uses a constrained input/output model run; truncation and output caps can affect anchor retention. The report makes no endpoint requests and loads no external assets.
limitations: Ground truth is SOURCE-ONLY AI-assisted selected anchors, NOT human gold or whole-document precision/recall. Exact substring presence does not assess factual fidelity, usability, or structural relationships. Human acceptance gates are NOT ASSESSED; no threshold achievement is certified. This purposive sample does not establish population accuracy. No uncertainty interval is claimed.
